aciklama: Bölüm 7 görsellerinin üretim istemleri ve kaydı. Üslup ve yasaklar b06 ile aynı (u01-d); dönem 585-590, Ukâz ve Mekke. Efendimiz hiçbir görsele çizilmez: ya onun gözünden bakılır ya da oynatıcı nurlu figürü çizer.

uslup.istem: Flat-shape illustration for a documentary motion comic in a paper cut-out style: layered flat shapes with clear depth planes, each plane like a sheet of textured paper with a soft shadow beneath it. Muted, low-saturation earth palette: sand, ochre, raw umber, warm grey stone; deep indigo for night, soft apricot for dawn and dusk. Gentle atmospheric haze, clean readable silhouettes, calm and respectful mood. Setting: Arabia around 585-590 CE — Mecca (a narrow valley among bare, rocky mountains with small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone and the low, roofless Ka'ba) and the open, stony valley of the Ukaz fair between Ta'if and Nakhla. Cinematic 16:9 framing.

referans.not: u01-d, Erdem seçti (2026-11-13). Her üretime image_references olarak verilir; yalnız üslup ve palet için, kompozisyon için değil.

uslup.yasaklar: No minarets, no domes, no crescents, no arches, no tiles, no Ottoman or modern architecture, no modern Masjid al-Haram. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. Ordinary people may show their faces, drawn simply in the same flat paper cut-out style, dignified, not photorealistic. The Prophet Muhammad appears only when the prompt asks for him, and then only as a tall, dignified figure entirely covered in soft warm golden-white light, wearing a green turban; no face, skin, hands or body detail visible inside the light. His wives, children, parents and wet nurse never show a face: only from behind, as distant silhouettes, or as hands and fabric details. No other prophet in any form: no figure, silhouette, shadow, hand or foot, only a soft warm light. No angels. No blood.
uslup.katman_kurali: Katmanlar ayrı üretilir. Gök katmanı hariç her katman düz, tek renk #00B140 (yeşil perde) zemin üzerinde istenir; zemin sonra `tools/gorsel_katman.py` ile silinip şeffaf WebP yapılır. Konu yeşil içeriyorsa (ör. s06'daki yeşil temel taşları) zemin mavi perde #0047BB istenir ve betik `--mavi` ile çalıştırılır; gök `--opak` ile. Görsel 16:9 kadrajdan her yöne %10 taşacak genişlikte düşünülür; ana öğe alt %25'e (altyazı alanı) düşmez.
uslup.yesil_perde_eki: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green background (#00B140), no shadows on the background, no green tint on the subject.
bilincli_olarak_cizilmeyenler: Efendimiz: s07 ve s13'te oynatıcı nurlu figür olarak çizer (kim: efendimiz); görsellerde yeri boş bırakılır. s08 onun gözünden: el, kol, beden yok.
Savaş: kan, yara, ölü ya da yaralı beden, saplanmış ok yok; çarpışmalar uzak ve ayrıntısız (toz bulutu). Öldürme anı (Berrâd-Urve) çizilmez.
Silah: yalnız Ficâr sahnelerinde basit yay, ok ve yuvarlak deri kalkan (FİCÂR s. 52: oklar, kalkan); kılıç kınında.

Ukâz: kaynakta görünüş: taşlık, su kaynakları olan geniş vadi; alışveriş, şiir okuma; kabilelerin bayraklı yerleri (UKÂZ s. 61); şairlerin kırmızı deriden çadırları (UKÂZ s. 62). Yazılı şiir tomarı ve Kâbe'ye asılan şiir çizilmez (tartışmalı).
Hilfü'l-fudûl yemini: biçimi kaynakta yok; el birleştirme, kılıç ya da başka işaret çizilmez. Hacerülesved suyu içilmesi (HİLFÜ'L-FUDÛL s. 32) anlatımda olmadığı için çizilmez.
Abdullah b. Cüd'ân'ın evi: kaynakta tarif yok; dönemin sade Mekke evi (nesne-mekke-evler), zenginlik süsle değil genişlikle.

istemler.konu: The Ukaz fair seen from a distance: a wide, stony valley with a few small springs and low scrub, ringed by low bare hills under a clear sky. Across the valley stands a large seasonal fair: simple cloth awnings on poles, low tents of dark goat hair and a few of red leather, goods laid out on mats (bales of cloth, leather, jars, baskets), kneeling camels, and a crowd of small, undetailed people moving between them. Here and there a plain cloth banner on a pole marks where a tribe has camped. Keep the foreground in the lower third mostly open, sandy ground.

kisiler.tarif: small, undetailed Arab men and a few women in muted brown, sand and grey-blue clothes
kisiler.poz: spread across the fair in small groups, walking, trading, talking.
kneeling or standing among the tents.

istemler.isik: LIGHT: even, neutral daylight from the front-left, soft shadows under people, animals and objects so they sit on the ground; no glow, no dramatic light.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, buildings of stone, domes, minarets, writing or lettering on banners, crosses, idols, blood.
istemler.not: UKÂZ (c. 42, s. 61-62): Tâif ile Nahle arasında, taşlık, su kaynakları olan geniş vadi; kabilelerin bayrak ya da işaretle belirlenmiş yerleri; şairler kırmızı deriden çadırlarda şiir okurdu. Panayırın görünüşü başka ayrıntıda kaynakta yok.

istemler.konu: At the fair: a poet stands and recites with one hand raised, while a small group of men of different tribes listens, some sitting, some standing. Calm, peaceful.

kisiler.tarif: a poet, a man of about 40 with a short black beard, a grey-blue cloak over a cream tunic, an off-white head cloth
kisiler.poz: standing at the left, one hand raised as he recites, facing right.
two sitting cross-legged and two standing at the right, all turned towards the poet, listening.

istemler.yerlesim: The poet stands at the left; the listeners sit or stand side by side at the right; everyone's feet or seated base on one horizontal line in the lower part of the image.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, women, children, scrolls, writing, tents, ground, buildings.
istemler.not: UKÂZ (s. 62), ARAP (c. 3, s. 324): şairler en güzel şiirlerini Ukâz'da okurdu. Kişilerin görünüşü kaynakta yok.

istemler.konu: A quarrel breaking out at the fair: two groups of men face each other angrily, one man in the middle boasting with his chest out; two older men step between the groups with open hands to calm them. No one is hit or hurt.

kisiler.tarif: a boastful man of about 30 with a black beard, sand-coloured cloak, off-white head cloth
kisiler.poz: in the centre-left, chin raised, one hand on his chest.
at the left behind the boastful man, frowning.
at the right, facing them angrily, fists clenched at their sides.

kisiler.tarif: two older men with grey beards in brown cloaks
kisiler.poz: in the middle between the groups, arms out, palms open, calming them.

istemler.yerlesim: All nine men stand side by side on one horizontal foot line in the lower part of the image; the two groups face each other with the two peacemakers between them.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, weapons drawn, swords, blood, wounds, women, children, ground, tents, buildings.
istemler.not: FİCÂR (s. 52): birinci Ficâr Ukâz'da bir adamın 'Arapların en şereflisi benim' diye övünmesiyle başladı. Sahnede saldırı ya da yara gösterilmez.

istemler.konu: A lone man crouches behind a large rock, half-hidden, watching something far away to the left with a cold, determined look.

kisiler.tarif: a lean man of about 35 with an unkempt black beard, a dark-brown cloak, a dark head cloth pulled low; a sheathed sword at his side
kisiler.poz: crouching behind the rock at its right side, looking left over it.

istemler.izin: the single large sand-coloured rock he hides behind, which is drawn.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, drawn sword, blood, horse, camel, any other person, ground, sky.
istemler.not: FİCÂR (s. 52), İbn Hişâm (s. 118): Kinâneli Berrâd b. Kays, Urve'yi takip edip öldürdü. Öldürme anı çizilmez; görünüşü kaynakta yok (kötü bilinen biri).

istemler.konu: Two groups of men in the desert at a distance, seen from the side: at the left a group of Quraysh men hurrying away to the left with a few loaded camels; at the right, some distance behind, a larger group of Hawazin men running after them with bows and spears raised. Dust kicked up at their feet.

kisiler.poz: the left group, hurrying left, some looking back over their shoulders.
walking quickly among the left group.

kisiler.tarif: small, undetailed Hawazin tribesmen in dark brown and grey cloaks and head cloths, with simple bows and spears
kisiler.poz: the right group, running left after them.

istemler.yerlesim: All figures form one long horizontal band in the lower part of the image, seen exactly from the side, all feet on the same horizontal line, with a clear gap between the two groups.
istemler.izin: a little dust at the feet of the runners.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, horses, fighting, blood, fallen people, ground, buildings, sky.
istemler.not: İbn Hişâm (s. 118): Kureyş Ukâz'dan ayrıldı, Hevâzin peşlerine düştü, Harem'e girene kadar çarpıştılar. Binek ve sayı kaynakta yok; atlı çizilmez.

istemler.konu: Four men of Quraysh in earnest discussion: Abu Talib stands serious and unwilling, one hand slightly raised as if saying 'not in the sacred months'; Harb ibn Umayya and the old Abdullah ibn Jud'an speak to him insistently; Zubayr stands a little behind, listening.

kisiler.poz: standing at the left, facing right, serious, one hand raised slightly.
standing centre-right, facing left, gesturing firmly with an open hand.
standing at the right, facing left, leaning on his staff, speaking.
standing between Abu Talib and Harb, one step behind them, listening.

istemler.yerlesim: All four stand side by side on one horizontal foot line in the lower part of the image.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, weapons, children, women, ground, buildings.
istemler.not: FİCÂR (s. 52), KUREYŞ (s. 443): Ebû Tâlib haram aylar gerekçesiyle razı olmadı; Abdullah b. Cüd'ân ve Harb ısrar etti; Hâşimoğulları Zübeyr komutasında katıldı. Yüzler çizilebilir.

istemler.konu: The men of the Hashim clan ready to set out with Zubayr: Zubayr in front, the others behind him with simple bows and round leather shields. Calm and serious. Leave a clear empty gap at the right of the group, about one person wide, where someone of a young man's height will be added later.

kisiler.poz: standing at the left front, facing right, a round leather shield on his arm.

kisiler.tarif: men of the Hashim clan, Arab men aged 30 to 50 with black or greying beards, in off-white head cloths and muted brown, grey and ochre cloaks, each with a simple bow or a round leather shield
kisiler.poz: standing side by side to the right of Zubayr.

istemler.yerlesim: Everyone stands side by side on one horizontal foot line in the lower part of the image; leave an empty gap about one person wide at the right end of the row, then green space.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, a young man or boy, any figure in the gap, drawn swords, blood, horses, ground, buildings.
istemler.not: İbn Hişâm (s. 118), FİCÂR (s. 52): amcaları onu yanlarında götürdü. Efendimiz'i oynatıcı nurlu figür olarak boşluğa koyar; görselde çizilmez.

istemler.konu: A desert battlefield seen through the eyes of a young man standing just behind his uncles: in the foreground, three men stand with their backs to the viewer, holding round leather shields and bows; far in the distance a large cloud of dust where two crowds clash, small and undetailed. On the sand in front of the viewer lie several spent arrows, scattered. Bare hills, clear sky.

kisiler.tarif: the viewer's uncles, Arab men seen only from behind, in off-white head cloths and muted brown, indigo-grey and ochre cloaks, with round leather shields and bows
kisiler.poz: standing in the middle ground with their backs to the viewer, facing the distant battle; no faces visible.

istemler.isik: LIGHT: even, neutral daylight from the front-left, soft shadows under people, animals and objects so they sit on the ground; no glow, no dramatic light.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, the viewer's hands, arms, feet or body, blood, wounds, fallen people, arrows sticking in anyone, faces of the three uncles, horses, buildings.
istemler.not: İbn Hişâm (s. 119): 'Amcalarıma ok verirdim.' FİCÂR (s. 52): atılan okları kalkanla karşılayıp toplayarak onlara verirdi. Onun gözünden; Efendimiz çizilmez.

istemler.konu: After the battle: two crowds of men walking slowly away from each other across the desert, one to the left and one to the right, tired, some carrying shields; a gap of empty space between them. Small and undetailed.

kisiler.tarif: small, undetailed Arab men in muted brown and grey cloaks
kisiler.poz: the left group, walking away to the left.

kisiler.tarif: small, undetailed Arab men in darker brown and grey cloaks
kisiler.poz: the right group, walking away to the right.

istemler.yerlesim: Both groups form one long horizontal band in the lower part of the image, all feet on the same horizontal line, with an empty gap in the middle.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, fallen people, blood, wounds, horses, ground, sky.
istemler.not: İbn Hişâm (s. 119), FİCÂR (s. 52): Kureyş ve Kinâne kazandı. Ölü ve yaralı gösterilmez.

istemler.konu: In the market of Mecca: the Yemeni merchant stands beside his bundled goods, holding out an open hand and asking to be paid; al-As ibn Wa'il turns half away with a dismissive wave of his hand, refusing.

kisiler.poz: standing at the left, facing right, one hand held out, palm up, a pleading look; bundles of cloth and leather at his feet.
standing at the right, body turned half away to the right, head turned back, one hand waving dismissively.

istemler.izin: the merchant's three bundles of goods on the ground beside him, which are drawn.
istemler.yerlesim: Both men stand side by side on one horizontal foot line in the lower part of the image, with clear space between them.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, money, coins, other people, ground, buildings, stalls.
istemler.not: HİLFÜ'L-FUDÛL (s. 31-32), Hadislerle İslâm c. 3: Zübeydli tüccar malını Âs b. Vâil'e sattı, parasını alamadı.

istemler.konu: Early morning in Mecca, wide view across the valley: on the top of a bare, rocky hill rising beside the town, a single small man stands with both arms raised, calling out loudly over the town. Below, the flat-roofed houses built like the attached reference and the low, roofless Ka'ba as a small dark block; a few tiny people in front of the houses look up towards the hill.

kisiler.poz: very small, standing on the hilltop at the upper right, both arms raised, facing the town.
in front of the houses, looking up towards the hill.

istemler.isik: LIGHT: soft early-morning daylight, low sun from the left; no glow, no light rays.
istemler.yasak: the Prophet, any glowing figure, halo, minarets, domes, crowds on the hill, writing.
istemler.not: HİLFÜ'L-FUDÛL (s. 32): tüccar Ebûkubeys tepesine çıkıp mağduriyetini şiirle dile getirdi. Tepenin biçimi kaynakta yok; sade, kayalık.

istemler.konu: Daytime, the courtyard of Abdullah ibn Jud'an's house in Mecca, a plain house of stone and mudbrick like the attached reference but larger, with a wide courtyard. The old Abdullah ibn Jud'an sits on a low bench against the wall; Zubayr bends towards him and speaks earnestly; around the courtyard, men of Quraysh sit on the ground and listen. Bare mountains of Mecca above the courtyard wall.

istemler.konu: The same courtyard as in the attached wide image: the men of Quraysh now stand in a group around the old Abdullah ibn Jud'an and Zubayr, serious and solemn, as they swear an oath together. Leave a clear empty space on the ground at the right-centre, about one person wide, where a tall figure will be added later.
